mapper.select: SELECT rr.review_id, rr.review_type, rr.review_result, rr.review_comment, su.real_name AS reviewer_name, rr.created_at FROM review_record rr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = rr.reviewer_id AND su.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rr.project_id = #{projectId} AND rr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC, rr.review_id DESC

SELECT history.review_id, history.project_id, cp.project_name, history.requirement_name, history.version_no, history.decision, history.comment, su.real_name AS reviewer_name, history.created_at, history.review_type FROM ( SELECT mr.id AS review_id, pm.project_id, req.requirement_name, pm.version_no, mr.decision, mr.comment, mr.reviewer_id, mr.created_at, 'material' AS review_type FROM material_review mr JOIN project_material pm ON pm.material_id = mr.material_version_id AND pm.is_deleted = 0 JOIN material_requirement req ON req.requirement_id = pm.requirement_id AND req.is_deleted = 0 WHERE mr.reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} AND mr.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT rr.review_id, rr.project_id, NULL AS requirement_name, NULL AS version_no, rr.review_result AS decision, rr.review_comment AS comment, rr.reviewer_id, rr.created_at, 'project' AS review_type FROM review_record rr WHERE rr.reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} AND rr.review_type = 'teacher_project' AND rr.is_deleted = 0 ) history JOIN competition_project cp ON cp.project_id = history.project_id AND cp.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = history.reviewer_id AND su.is_deleted = 0 WHERE (#{admin} = TRUE OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member advisor WHERE advisor.project_id = history.project_id AND advisor.user_id = #{reviewerId} AND advisor.member_role = 'advisor' AND advisor.is_deleted = 0 )) ORDER BY history.created_at DESC, history.review_type DESC, history.review_id DESC
